annotations.title: تقرير السوق الشهري / Monthly market report

description: Use this when the user asks about the Saudi government tender market in one month: how many tenders were issued and awarded, their value, the change on the month before, and the most active entities and activities. Takes the month as YYYY-MM. The stage is in_progress, preliminary or final. Not for a single entity or company. تقرير سوق المنافسات لشهر: العدد والتغيّر والجهات والأنشطة والترسيات وقيمها ومرحلته.
